protocol.user_sampling: independent uniform eligible users with replacement for each branch
protocol.intervention_scope: Only nonterminal cutoff probabilities differ for histories longer than 12 events. Prefix length and target exposure can consequently change.
protocol.matched_control_status: Unverified: supplied aggregate scores do not establish matched control execution. This invocation trains only its selected policy.
protocol.policy_coverage_definition: Both cutoff inverse CDFs use each terminal example's same original uniform without additional RNG draws. Changed occurrence counts compare event indices; changed item counts compare item IDs, so repeated items can have changed occurrences but unchanged labels. These are sampling audits, not validation treatment effects.
protocol.patience_unit: epochs since earliest best checkpoint; checked at validation
protocol.normalization: separate means over all valid targets in each branch

output_head.denominator: all real items 1..itemnum; PAD and MASK excluded
output_head.reduction: summed CE divided by branch valid-target count

protocol.reconstruction: latest maxlen events; 0.15 MASK-only with one-target fallback
protocol.terminal_context: at most maxlen-1 preceding events followed by MASK

epoch_branch_metrics.objective_definition: Mean over updates of 0.5 times reconstruction target-mean CE plus 0.5 times terminal target-mean CE. Reconstruction target counts vary across updates; global target-weighted CE cannot reconstruct this mean batch objective.

cumulative_branch_metrics.coefficient_mass_definition: sum of target coefficients across updates; neither loss-value share nor gradient share

training_branch_allocation.terminal_draw_fraction_definition: Cumulative fraction of terminal examples drawn from histories where recent10 and uniform have different nonterminal probabilities; includes endpoint draws, whose probability remains unchanged.

run_summary.comparison_status: Unverified: supplied aggregate scores do not establish matched control execution. This invocation trains only its selected policy.

pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown.category_status: unavailable: item categories are not supplied
pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown.corruption_branch_status: Branch counts cover only batches whose sequence, positive and negative arrays exactly match sampler bookkeeping. Unmatched batches are unavailable; observed same-item inputs cannot identify their branches.

metric_definitions.embedding_directional_alignment: Mean pairwise cosine of fixed-seed sampled real-item embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. Measures directional alignment, not conclusive collapse or recommendation diversity. Null means unavailable.
metric_definitions.representation_geometry: Separate fixed-seed real-item and appended-MASK user samples. Reports raw mean L2 norm, mean squared centered coordinates, and singular values of the centered representation matrix. RankMe = exp(-sum(p*log(p))), p=sigma/sum(sigma); zero spectra and fewer than two samples yield unavailable rank/statistics. User readout uses the maximum nonpadding index.
metric_definitions.training_branch_allocation: Unavailable or unresolved legacy allocation metadata; do not infer Bernoulli allocation or objective accounting from diagnostic-loader coverage.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean of (pos_logit - neg_logit) over valid positions; higher means clearer separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: 10th percentile of (pos_logit - neg_logit); lower suggests many hard/confusing cases.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction where neg_logit > pos_logit (margin < 0); lower is better.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction where (pos_logit - neg_logit) < eps; higher means weak separation.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts low-margin and wrong-rank supervised real-item positions. Category breakdowns are unavailable because item categories are not supplied. Observed input counts distinguish MASK, different real item and same real item, but cannot identify exact stochastic corruption branches without matched sampler bookkeeping. Empty batch counts measure probe coverage; empty margin metrics are null. The legacy supervised_positions and observed-input counters require both a valid positive and a valid negative. valid_target_positions counts real positive labels at nonpadding inputs independently of negative availability. terminal_position_targets counts those labels at each sequence's maximum nonpadding index. Terminal-position coverage divides that count by presented_sequences; it is null when no sequences were measured. These diagnostic-loader counts do not establish the training branch allocation: both reconstruction and terminal examples can supervise their final position. These training probes are not host validation HR@10.
